source_title: Crashes after 1.19.3 Paper version (Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity.dC()" because "entity" is null)

fix_solution: 【已证实】维护者关闭结论：插件非法修改服务端内部状态（TickThread/isTickThread）导致 NPE，需排查并移除违规插件（依据：lynxplay 在 issue 评论确认并关闭）
